parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-19 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.2 | 25.53 | 25.53
2 | 7309.9 | 22.02 | 47.55
3 | 4367.7 | 0.42 | 47.97
4 | 4556.7 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-19
Curve type: Type A
Aquifer depth: 25.53 - 47.55 m
Recommendation: Drill through the weathered overburden into the competent basement rock. Target a depth of at least 48 meters to intercept potential fracture zones.
